description:
Proposed procurement for NSN 5330004195357 RETAINER,PACKING:
Line 0001 Qty 108    UI EA  Deliver To:  By: 0089 DAYS ADO
This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 1. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 16. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots.
Approved source is 5F573 218MT2T.
The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice.  Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available.
All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered.
Quotes must be submitted electronically.
